messages.subject: geom_errorbar with y aesthetic only
parts:
I have a suggestion, please.  I think it would be nice if geom_errorbar worked without having to supply ymin and ymax.  This would make for cleaner code, and it would make it easier to teach novices how to add summary lines to their graphs.  Please see example below.

Thank you,

Dave Cooper
--------------------------------------------------------------------
require(ggplot2)
require(plyr)

d = data.frame(x=rep(1:5, 4))
d = mutate(d, y = x + rnorm(20))
m = ddply(d, ~x, summarize, ybar=mean(y))

g = ggplot(d, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point()

# works:
g + stat_summary(geom='errorbar', fun.y=mean, fun.ymin=mean, fun.ymax=mean)
g + geom_errorbar(data=m, aes(y=ybar, ymin=ybar, ymax=ybar))

# does not work, but I wish it would:
g + stat_summary(geom='errorbar', fun.y=mean)
g + geom_errorbar(data=m, aes(y=ybar))
